issue: jsonpointer.py leaks ValueError when a valid numeric array index exceeds Python's integer digit conversion limit. All public resolve, to_last and set operations must raise JsonPointerException for invalid sequence indices; resolve with a default must return that exact default. Numeric object member keys remain strings, however long. Preserve ordinary array indices, end-of-list handling and input mutation behavior. Add NEW regression tests.

TimestampSigner.unsign in src/itsdangerous/timed.py leaks a datetime ValueError when an invalid signature contains a decoded timestamp outside datetime's supported year range. Report BadTimeSignature with the original payload and date_signed=None for malformed timestamps on the invalid-signature path. Preserve valid roundtrips, ordinary invalid-signature date_signed metadata and expiry behavior. The public timed serializer must retain its BadSignature-family error contract too. Add NEW regression tests; do not edit existing tests.

python-dotenv treats an unquoted empty value followed by whitespace and an inline comment as the comment text. KEY= # comment and a tab-separated comment should give an empty string. Keep KEY=#literal and hashes inside nonempty or quoted values literal as appropriate. Preserve keys without equals as None, adjacent lines, export bindings, CRLF, dotenv_values stream parsing and load_dotenv override behavior. Add NEW regression tests without editing original tests.

slugify.special.add_uppercase_char returns before processing every original translation, so PRE_TRANSLATIONS lacks uppercase variants for later German and other non-Latin characters. Process every original pair, retain existing uppercase entries without duplicates and keep the existing capitalization convention and ordinary slugify/smart_truncate behavior. The public PRE_TRANSLATIONS and replacement-enabled slugify must agree. Add NEW regression tests; do not edit the original test.py.

JsonPointer.join in jsonpointer.py discards the left operand subclass, returning a base JsonPointer. Preserve the left concrete class for pointer, string and iterable suffixes and for / chaining. Respect subclass from_parts dispatch, escaped member names, input immutability, ordinary base-pointer results and invalid-suffix exception behavior. Add NEW regression tests without editing original tests.

JsonPointer.set in jsonpointer.py leaks TypeError or IndexError for invalid assignment targets: strings, immutable tuple elements and out-of-range list indices. Convert unsupported item assignment and list-index errors to JsonPointerException, including through public set_pointer, without mutating the document on failure. Preserve valid mapping/list updates, list append with -, copy behavior when inplace=False and root replacement. Add NEW regression tests; existing tests stay unchanged.
